castle_start.label: Wake the blower with a firm little press
castle_start.note: Press the low switch, release it and listen as the real fan starts.

castle_stop.label: Let the blower wind down
castle_stop.note: Hold the stop pad then wait for the fan and fabric to settle.

castle_vent_open.label: Let air sigh through the low valve
castle_vent_open.note: Unseat the valve cap in two twists; the empty house loses pressure.

castle_vent_close.label: Seat the valve and check the seal
castle_vent_close.note: Turn the real cap closed and press its lip; no repair material is invented.

castle_door_open.label: Roll the mesh door into its keeper
castle_door_open.note: Release the buckle, pull the low cord and roll the actual mesh upward.

castle_door_close.label: Lower the mesh without trapping a wing
castle_door_close.note: Ease the mesh down through three real positions while the helper stays outside.

castle_unbuckle.label: Unclip the little door buckle
castle_unbuckle.note: Squeeze and pull the clip; its two halves visibly separate.

castle_buckle.label: Fasten the mesh for the night
castle_buckle.note: Lay the door flat, bring the clip halves together and snap them shut.

castle_tie_left.label: Draw the left guy rope snug
castle_tie_left.note: Pull the left rope toward its peg and tuck the working end into its real knot.

castle_tie_right.label: Set the right guy rope against a tug
castle_tie_right.note: Take slack from the right rope, seat the knot, then test it with a second tug.

castle_slack_left.label: Unpick the left rope’s loop
castle_slack_left.note: Loosen the loop at the left peg; the rope develops a visible sag.

castle_slack_right.label: Feed slack into the right guy rope
castle_slack_right.note: Pull the right knot free and feed the loose end back through the loop.

castle_apron_flat.label: Smooth the curled landing apron
castle_apron_flat.note: Work from the rolled edge toward the body, flattening three sections of real fabric.

castle_apron_fold.label: Fold the landing apron out of the rain
castle_apron_fold.note: Lift the low hem, roll it in stages and pat the final fold flat.

castle_flag_up.label: Hoist the little roof pennant
castle_flag_up.note: Pull the low halyard twice and secure it at the cleat; the roof flag really rises.

castle_flag_down.label: Lower the pennant before the gusts
castle_flag_down.note: Feed the halyard through the low cleat in measured lengths, lowering the actual pennant.

castle_hose_straight.label: Uncurl the blower hose
castle_hose_straight.note: Open the stored coil, seat the hose and straighten its visible kink.

castle_hose_stow.label: Coil the hose beside the silent blower
castle_hose_stow.note: Disconnect airflow before winding the visible hose into a compact coil.

castle_grill_clean.label: Brush fluff from the blower grille
castle_grill_clean.note: Turn the fan off and sweep existing grille dust with a wing; no brush materializes.

castle_mesh_shake.label: Shake dew from the mesh hem
castle_mesh_shake.note: Lift and shake the actual wet mesh hem; droplets come only from stored moisture.

castle_roof_drain.label: Ease collected water down the roof seam
castle_roof_drain.note: Pull the low drain cord so real collected water runs down the outside seam.

castle_apron_clean.label: Sweep muddy prints off the landing flap
castle_apron_clean.note: Flatten the flap and sweep its existing footmarks away with alternating wing strokes.

castle_seam_check.label: Pinch-test the lower stitched seam
castle_seam_check.note: Pinch and release the actual lower seam; record an inspection without repairing it.

castle_gauge_check.label: Lean in and read the pressure dial
castle_gauge_check.note: Point at the true inflation needle and share its current reading; the dial is never faked.

castle_open_day.label: Open the little castle
segments: Seat the valve and check the seal
Wake the blower with a firm little press
castle_open_day.note: Uncoil the air supply, seal the valve, flatten the landing, release the mesh and finally start the blower.

castle_close_night.label: Last bounce, lights out
segments: Fasten the mesh for the night
Lower the pennant before the gusts
castle_close_night.note: Stop the fan, lower and buckle the mesh, then bring the pennant down for the night.

castle_rain_cover.label: Button up for rain
segments: Lower the mesh without trapping a wing
Fasten the mesh for the night
Fold the landing apron out of the rain
Lower the pennant before the gusts
castle_rain_cover.note: Stop the blower before closing the doorway and rolling the apron out of the rain.

castle_after_rain.label: Shake yesterday out
segments: Ease collected water down the roof seam
Shake dew from the mesh hem
Sweep muddy prints off the landing flap
castle_after_rain.note: Drain stored roof water, shake droplets from the mesh and sweep real tracks from the landing.

castle_winter_layup.label: Put the castle to bed
segments: Coil the hose beside the silent blower
Let air sigh through the low valve
Feed slack into the right guy rope
Fold the landing apron out of the rain
castle_winter_layup.note: Coil the stopped blower hose, vent the chamber, loosen both ropes and fold the apron. This leaves the house closed for play.

castle_spring_retension.label: Wake the guy ropes
segments: Draw the left guy rope snug
Set the right guy rope against a tug
castle_spring_retension.note: Lay out the hose, tighten both sides separately, and inspect the seam without pretending to repair it.

castle_dust_service.label: Give the blower a breather
segments: Brush fluff from the blower grille
Wake the blower with a firm little press
Lean in and read the pressure dial
castle_dust_service.note: Switch off before sweeping the grille, straighten the air supply, restart and read the actual pressure.

castle_guest_welcome.label: Make an entrance
segments: Sweep muddy prints off the landing flap
Roll the mesh door into its keeper
castle_guest_welcome.note: Sweep the landing, unbuckle and roll the mesh, then hoist the welcome pennant.

castle_pressure_check.label: Follow the escaping air
segments: Lean in and read the pressure dial
Seat the valve and check the seal
Lean in and read the pressure dial
castle_pressure_check.note: Compare pressure before and after sealing the valve and straightening the hose. A reading is not a repair.

castle_evening_air.label: Let the fabric breathe
segments: Shake dew from the mesh hem
Let air sigh through the low valve
castle_evening_air.note: Stop the blower, shake the wet mesh, open the valve and leave the apron flat to dry. No invented puddle is removed.
